substats: Arena-style preset: Skill Haste first, then Skill AMP, crit rate, crit damage, damage reduction; no accuracy or focus
why: The boss is not gated by accuracy the way stages are, so the lines go to damage and cast rate; most top posts reuse their arena preset.
Milk arrives sooner; one poster went from 50-60G to 75.4G on a move-speed preset that showed less power, and others report Milk coming out at once.
서신우 saw no misses on his Conquest preset and fights on it; 섬영's weekly best was set on a preset labelled 토벌.
뱅국's guide picks gear for power; the other guides trade displayed power for damage lines, and the move-speed case shows lower power scoring higher.
